analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 61.4 to 68.9, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram improved from 1.5868 to 1.7210, strengthening upward momentum. A Higher Low pattern formed with the 5-day low at $330.18 and 20-day low at $308.21, reinforcing the recovery trend. The current price of $342.65 is nearing the 52-week high of $345.34, indicating a continuation of the uptrend.
